entry_points.text: Secure-computing registers availability and logged-mask controls with auditing handler; cache inspection needs admin and sighand and prints bitmaps; early helper parses fatal-diagnostics flag.
Restart invokes per-task callback; mask and pending validate size and copy prior; timed wait copies info only on success; kill forwards to generic send; thread kills reject non-positive ids.
Central handler clears notify, rejects when no work, freezes, then loops termination, group stop and traps; traced stop sleeps until resume; notify and async completion queue after checks.

exports.text: String sysctl handlers delegate to a shared bounded routine; mask update, temp mask install with restore, and 32-bit siginfo narrowing are exported.
Numeric process send resolves ids in caller namespace with uid pairing check; fault helpers build cleared records for forcing or sending.
Timer helpers init entries, queue or park or drop on expiry, and flush removes timer entries from both queues; kernel installer purges ignored signals.
Debugger notification validates trap shape then enters traced stop; work drain steals callback lists atomically and runs each, handling exit marker.

hazards.text: Fatal reports use fallback and fault-tolerant reads; pending without descriptor synthesizes generic info losing identity; user sizes and pointers need validation with mask restore paired.
Arch hook may fault so lock drops across it; detach or fatal needs recheck; preemption can add latency; bad stop numbers warn once; ignored node found linked warns and leaks ref.
Dropping sighand opens arrival windows requiring revalidation; concurrent fatal arrivals race on exit code; workers needing cleanup must not be force-exited.

Timer versus user origins drive flush versus rebuild; stop, trap and continued reasons select payload; event bits drive clearing; job bits sequence stops; traced, stopped and freezable sleeps plus sync priority define modes.

invariants.text: Mask to text joins labels failing on overflow; text to mask splits on spaces failing on unknown token; privileged update rejects unknown and allow bit; audit renders old and new with placeholders.
Shared string treats missing storage as empty success; writes append up to limit minus one stopping at nul or newline; reads honor offset and append newline when room remains.

Pending minus blocked selects lowest deliverable with sync priority in first word; init is unhandled, custom and dying fatal-pending are handled, traced counts handled; sync dequeue scans for kernel sync entries.
Mask updater applies block, unblock or set; temp install treats null as no-op else arms restore; pending merges queues then intersects blocked; delivery unions handler mask and disarms alt stack.

Inbound info copies from user, forces number and validates; outbound clears and narrows layout fields; timed wait tries immediate dequeue then narrows mask across freezable sleep; kill records carry scope and sender ids.

Pidfd checks namespace ancestry and single scope flag, allowing reserved codes only for narrow self sends; targeted send maps race to success; queueinfo rejects foreign reserved codes and routes scope.

Flush retains non-timer and unlinks timer entries; queue notifies monitors and sets bit; target resolver substitutes current when eligible; ignored periodic parks while oneshot after periodic drops prior.

Debugger allows cancel to zero, rebuilds changed numbers as user-origin and requeues when blocked; fault dequeues first with ignore rescan, stop attempting group stop and others fatal; slabs cached and fault tags stripped.

locks.text: Sighand lock guards pending recompute, queue mutation, merge, scan and install; assertion checks held; lock drops around orphan test, coredump and group exit then reacquires.
Timer send holds read protection and requires sighand; timed wait holds sighand only for dequeue and mask swap; targeted lookup uses read sections; own mask updates lockless.

Traced stop drops sighand around arch hook and before notification and sleep; group-stop counts update under sighand while parent reports use task-list lock; freezer releases, jobctl leaves unlock to caller.
Group sends hold task-list read protection; pid forms use read sections with async requiring sighand; work drain steals via compare-exchange with pi-lock barrier then runs unlocked.

state_machines.text: Dequeue picks lowest eligible then collects: match removed with bit kept if same-number remains, timer entries transfer to out param, missing entry synthesizes user record; private drained before shared.

Positive ids send singly; zero targets caller group, negatives target named group, minus-one iterates all; delivery scan cycles freeze, sync then general dequeue, rewrite and disposition with rescan or exit.

Traced stop records trap, optionally joins group stop, notifies, sleeps frozen and clears transient state; group stop marks peers while counting then sleeps or traps; outer loop sequences exit, stop, traps and reports.
Work drain loops stealing head until null, processes exit marker once when exiting, invoking each chain in order before re-stealing.

structs.text: Log table pairs selectors with labels; sig-code table maps fault to fault layout and child, poll and sys to dedicated layouts; pending pairs mask with nodes; per-task holds restart, masks and alt-stack flags.
Timer links node with number, target, sequences and ignored node; task links private and shared pending, sighand, blocked mask, job-control flags, ptrace state and group-stop fields.

Availability lists kill_process, kill_thread, trap, errno, user_notif, trace, log, allow; handler offers current, default and exit modes; pidfd allows one scope; two signals stay unblockable with block, unblock, set.
